These are direct functional disruptions of autophagy pathway components. The abstract explicitly establishes that these findings belong to the CLN3-knockout cells through the CRISPR gene-editing experiments described. While the quote itself does not use the exact word "disrupts," the observed alterations in autophagy-lysosome system function in CLN3-knockout cells constitutes clear evidence that CLN3 disrupts autophagy pathway function. This qualifies as accept_inferred since the relationship is clearly established through the knockout experimental design and subsequent functional observations.
